intro: Mia is cast out as a jinx, the little girl everyone blames when something goes wrong. Then the elite Murphy family takes her in and sees something nobody else did: not a jinx, but a miracle. It reads like a heartwarming fantasy novel, now on screen: a tiny heroine, a family that chooses her, and a lot of people about to regret how they treated her.
why: A little heroine the world rejected, and a family that decides she is a blessing.
A gentle fantasy where the girl everyone rejected turns out to be the one people should have treasured.
Plenty of satisfying moments when those who called her a jinx see the truth.
Good pick if you like wholesome family stories with a touch of magic.
